note: What a route COSTS, and where it asks for the owner. Which checkpoints a route passes is NOT declared here — that already lives in checkpoint-registry.json `route_sets`, and a second copy of a closed set is the drift [A.10] exists to prevent. This file adds only what the checkpoint registry does not know: how long each checkpoint takes and how much of the owner's attention it asks for.
owner_line_note: Handed to the owner verbatim by the orchestrator, so it is written in the owner's language and lives in data rather than in code — the same reason the panel's knob labels do.
estimate_note: Every number below is an ESTIMATE and says so in the emitted plan (`source: estimate`). Once a stage has 3 or more measured runs in the project's trace, `dops plan emit` replaces it with the median and flips `source` to `measured`. There is no silent substitution: the field is always present, so a plan never claims to be measured when it is guessed.
